sources.usage: Primary public heritage text only; all government imagery/maps unused.
Existing story and four selected already-published public-domain originals.

facts.centroidMeaning: Official heritage parcel centroid, NOT either house corner or surveyed building centre.
facts.principalDwellings: The House and The Cottage, with domestic outbuildings; neither is the separate chapel.
facts.arrangement: House and Cottage lie toward the north of the property; House principal sections face north and kitchen/outbuildings form an open rear southern courtyard. Cottage lies east of the chapel. Main approach comes from the west.
facts.sourceFacadeTypes: Named Cottage photograph shows low hipped roof/veranda/chimneys; other homestead views show the distinct gabled/attic House with attached lower roof/veranda wings.

limitations: No original building footprints found in saved OSMquery; do not claim a native building plan. Story/Wikidata coordinate is coarse (~0.01degree precision) and not a house survey. Official site centroid is more precise for the parcel but cannot itself establish the dwellings’ exact relative positions. Unseen roofs/rooms/current colors and dimensional/metric registration need bounded explicit reconstruction.
